self_sha256_note: This preregistration config deliberately does NOT embed its own SHA256 to avoid a self-reference paradox. The external SHA256 is recorded by the run report, the run harness result JSON and the preregistration report JSON.

preregistration_report.sha256_note: written immediately after this config; it pins this config's SHA256

preregistered_before_metrics: This file and the preregistration report are written before any new validation NPZ is read for this experiment.
purpose: Without changing the frozen prompt_mean_vector hardware structure (Wt[128,2560], Wv[128,1024], [1,128] query, Gx128 dot), test whether adding a fixed-weight (1.0) softplus same-image wrong-prompt contrastive term to the spatial KL base loss makes the student learn the same-image other-task prompt discrimination that arm B of the prior spatial-student experiment failed (G2), while keeping the already-positive deployed retained-mass utility.

prior_negative_result.known_historical_defect: the prior report's B_selector_minus_L2_anchor_mass_k48 aggregation used base - metric (l2_anchor - selector); the correct sign is selector - l2_anchor. This experiment computes P5 as selector - baseline only. The prior report and trainer are NOT modified.
prior_negative_result.failed_gate: G2 prompt sensitivity (same-image other-task) was the only failing gate in the prior spatial-student experiment

scope.small_head_note: about 458752 trainable parameters in a Wt[128,2560]/Wv[128,1024] head; this is NOT 4B model training
scope.development_validation_note: the existing val split has already been used for development; this experiment is development validation only and must not be presented as final accuracy

existing_spatial_trainer.note: read-only reuse source; must remain byte-for-byte unchanged and must not be edited by this experiment

immutability_rule: Every pinned input and the preregistration config/report pair must be byte-for-byte unchanged before and after the experiment; the run records the pre-run and post-run SHA256 of every pinned input.

frozen_spatial_targets.grounding_area_target: exact bbox/grid-cell intersection area with bbox_1000 clipped to [0,1000] for boundary tolerance only; divide by total intersection area so mass sums to 1; hard-fail invalid or zero/negative-area boxes; applicable task: grounding
frozen_spatial_targets.pointing_bilinear_target: u=x*W/1000-0.5, v=y*H/1000-0.5; clamp u to [0,W-1], v to [0,H-1]; separable bilinear mass over the up to four neighboring centers; combine duplicate boundary indices and normalize to sum 1; no Gaussian and no bandwidth parameter; applicable task: pointing
frozen_spatial_targets.no_blending: spatial targets are never blended with the cached semantic teacher target
frozen_spatial_targets.no_tuning: target formulas are frozen before any metric and are not tuned after seeing metrics

split_rule.test_npz_action: never resolved, hashed, opened or scored; no test path is built from the index in this experiment

arms.name: A_SPATIAL_KL_CONTROL
arms.target: spatial (grounding area target / pointing bilinear target)

arms.name: B_SPATIAL_KL_CONTRASTIVE
arms.target: spatial (grounding area target / pointing bilinear target)

loss_definition.base: 0.5 * (KL(tg || pg_correct) + KL(tp || pp_correct)) where tg/tp are the frozen spatial targets, pg_correct is the grounding record scored with the grounding prompt and pp_correct is the pointing record scored with the pointing prompt
loss_definition.wrong_prompt_definition: for a grounding record the wrong prompt is the same image's pointing prompt; for a pointing record the wrong prompt is the same image's grounding prompt. Both KL terms still use the record's own spatial target.
loss_definition.image_pair_loss: the image-pair loss is the per-image total; batch loss is the mean over the image pairs in the deterministic batch

optimization.model_selection: arm A best by its own val base; arm B best by its own val total (base + contrastive); tie earliest epoch

validation_metrics.record_to_image_aggregation: average grounding and pointing record metrics before resampling
validation_metrics.same_image_other_task_control: score the same visual groups with the paired task prompt of the same image; the (correct - same) gap is the prompt-discrimination quantity
validation_metrics.cross_image_same_task_derangement: descriptive secondary control; deterministic split-local image derangement with same-task donor and no self-pair
validation_metrics.deployed_selection_proxy: at K=48 (descriptive also at K=64/96) use the existing score normalization/combine rule of evaluation.hardware_regular_token_selector.combine_scores with lambda_semantic from configs/hardware_regular_token_selector.json and the exact existing select_real_groups 3x3 anchor rule; arm B prompt-conditioned selector retained spatial-target mass is compared with the L2+anchor baseline retained spatial-target mass
validation_metrics.deployed_ndcg: evaluation.prompt_projection_distillation.ndcg_for_selected_indices (corrected selected-set NDCG) whenever deployed NDCG is reported

statistics.seed_aggregation: per-image median delta across the three seeds before bootstrap/permutation
primary_holm_family: P1 B minus A of the (correct minus same-image-other-task) spatial Spearman gap
P2 B minus A of the (correct minus same-image-other-task) spatial full NDCG gap
P3 B absolute (correct minus same-image-other-task) spatial Spearman gap
P4 B absolute (correct minus same-image-other-task) spatial full NDCG gap
P5 B deployed selector minus L2+anchor retained spatial-target mass at K48 (selector minus baseline)
statistics.primary_metric_policy: only these five tests decide the result; other K/method metrics are descriptive and cannot decide the result
statistics.p5_sign_rule: P5 per-image delta = selector_mass_k48 - l2_anchor_mass_k48 (selector minus baseline); the reverse sign is forbidden and unit-tested

gates.G1_correct_alignment_non_inferiority: both B-A correct-prompt spatial Spearman and full NDCG deltas satisfy: mean >= -0.02, 95% CI lower >= -0.05, and >= 2/3 seed means >= -0.02 (descriptive non-inferiority; NOT in the Holm family)
gates.G2_prompt_discrimination_gain: P1 and P2 both satisfy: mean > 0, 95% CI lower > 0, |dz| >= 0.2, Holm p < 0.05, positive mean in >= 2/3 seeds
gates.G3_prompt_discrimination_absolute: P3 and P4 both satisfy the same five conditions
gates.G4_deployed_K48_utility: P5 satisfies the same five conditions
gates.G5_collapse_removed: exact prompt-score invariance fraction <= 0.05 in every arm B seed
gates.G6_validation_learning: >= 2/3 arm B seeds have best_epoch > 0 and best val total < epoch0 val total
gates.G7_hardware_contract: runtime query remains [1,128]; FPGA scorer remains Gx128 dot; no token-axis max/softmax/exp; existing fixed-budget 3x3 anchor selection unchanged

decision_rule.PROMPT_CONTRASTIVE_STUDENT_NOT_ESTABLISH: arm B fails any of G1-G7
decision_rule.control_rule: arm A is a control and can never win
decision_rule.internal_test: no internal test evaluation in either case

prohibitions: no third arm and no arm target substitution after the preregistration
no contrastive weight, margin or softplus temperature tuning
no target blending, rank loss, auxiliary loss or hyperparameter search
no reading, resolving, hashing or scoring of internal test NPZ files
no internal test evaluation in either decision branch
no 4B model load, no feature re-extraction, no raw image read, no GPU, no network, no package installation
no modification of evaluation/train_spatial_prompt_selector.py or any existing report
no post-hoc change of the five-test Holm family, the gates or the decision rule
no post-hoc change of the corrected selected-set NDCG helper
no claim of final accuracy, CV-Bench task accuracy, hardware speedup or board deployment
authorization: DeepSeek Harness may process necessary code, metrics and derived data via api.deepseek.com; raw images, 4B weights, keys, proxy config and credentials are never read, uploaded or printed.
